  \caption{\textbf{How far through each task's rubric the trials got on RoboDojo-RC Tier~1.} One panel per task; each curve is one model configuration (M/H/XH: medium, high and extra-high reasoning effort; UF: ultrafast serving) and shows the share of its 20 trials whose autograde reached at least each subtask (a rubric checkpoint), so every curve starts at 100\% and can only fall. Subtasks are the rubric's non-zero levels, labelled with the level's score; Sort Objects' paired levels (0.33/0.34 and 0.66/0.67, the same number of objects sorted) are one subtask each. Colour identifies the model and marker shape the reasoning effort (circle medium, square high, triangle extra-high, diamond ultrafast); curves are offset slightly sideways so that those sharing a value stay visible. One curve per model: its highest-effort configuration, except GPT-6 Astra, drawn at high effort in ultrafast mode.}
